## Free guide
- Offer page guides hub (checklist + nine guides grouped by the ten checks, with where to start): https://clearoffer.site/guides.html
- Offer page checklist (10 checks before you send traffic): https://clearoffer.site/offer-page-checklist.html
- DE: Checkliste für Angebotsseiten (10 Prüfpunkte, German twin): https://clearoffer.site/angebotsseite-checkliste.html
- How to write the price section of a service page (formats, what goes next to the number, VAT wording, template): https://clearoffer.site/price-section-guide.html
- One call to action or several on a service page (picking the primary action, secondary actions, button wording, placement, CTA block): https://clearoffer.site/call-to-action-guide.html
- What proof to show on a service page when you have no testimonials yet (sample deliverable, worked example, process, verifiable credentials, clear terms, what never to fake, proof block): https://clearoffer.site/proof-without-testimonials.html
- How to write a service page headline that says who it is for and what they get (formula, before/after rewrites, mistakes, five-second test, first-screen block): https://clearoffer.site/service-page-headline.html
- How to describe your deliverable on a service page (six things to state: format, contents, delivery time, revisions, what the buyer provides, what is not included; before/after rewrites; custom work; what-you-get block): https://clearoffer.site/describe-your-deliverable.html
- How to write a "how it works" section that explains the next step before the click (three-step pattern: what the buyer sends, when they pay, what they receive and when; before/after rewrites; mistakes; copy-paste block): https://clearoffer.site/how-it-works-section.html
- How to show who is behind your service page (real name or company, location, working contact, EU imprint basics as general information, about-block pattern, before/after rewrites, mistakes, copy-paste block): https://clearoffer.site/who-is-behind-the-page.html
- How to test your offer page on a phone, end to end (15-minute self-test: setup on mobile data, six stages from first screen to confirmation, common failures, what to fix first, copy-paste checklist): https://clearoffer.site/phone-test-your-offer-page.html
- How to say who your service is for on the first screen (three ways to name the buyer: role, situation, problem; how narrow to go; more than one audience; made-up before/after rewrites; mistakes; copy-paste line): https://clearoffer.site/who-is-it-for.html
